nativeRoute: revenue-sharing /skill-api LDAP token proxy (default); explicitly authorized AK/SK only

loginFlow.steps: 优先复用 SKILL_LDAP_TOKEN；缺失由本机安全凭据注入 POST <rs-host>/skill-api/login {ldapCn,password}，不将密码放命令行/聊天。生产 RS host 在 owner 契约中待部署，不能自动切换 AK/SK。
loginFlow.authorization: Login, token creation/rotation/revocation and business writes require the current task scope; this discovery performs none.

tokenMechanism: raw Authorization LDAP token，3 天；RS 服务端托管 PaasConfig AK/SK 与节点路由；显式 AK/SK 模式 IOT_ADMIN_AK/SK 做 URL HmacSHA1。
subjectPermission: login 返回 ldapCn/expiresInSeconds 是申请回执；代理审计归属 LDAP cn；目标 node/environment 和只读设置回读单独验证。稳定独立身份探针尚缺。
expiryRevoke: POST /skill-api/logout raw Authorization 幂等撤销；过期重新 LDAP 登录，生产部署与 proxy ACL 需核实。

versionPolicy.rule: Candidate source and published contracts do not establish deployed compatibility. Verify the target instance version and read-only supported capabilities before enabling an adapter.

verification.scope: Read-only documentation/repository discovery; no login, token issuance, credential inspection or business API execution.
